target_customer: Cardiologists and clinicians who start or monitor patients on heart rhythm drugs, and device or digital health companies licensing the algorithms
problem: Patients starting drugs such as antiarrhythmics often need in person ECG monitoring for dosing safety; SafeBeat uses AI on ECGs from FDA cleared mobile monitors to let physicians guide therapy remotely.
business_model: B2B software for remote therapeutic monitoring plus algorithm licensing; product under development and not yet for sale
product_category: Digital health, AI ECG analysis for therapeutic monitoring

founders.name: Rachita Navara
founders.background_notes: Electrophysiology cardiologist and bioengineer per the YC page and company site.

founders.name: Kunj Patel
founders.background_notes: Pain physician with applied mathematics expertise per the company site; not on the YC page.

investors: NIH National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute (Direct to Phase II SBIR)

competitors.name: AliveCor
competitors.what: KardiaMobile 6L personal ECG with AI, cleared for QTc measurement to track drug induced QT prolongation, and planning biopharma partnerships
competitors.traction_then: FDA clearances including QTc in July 2021

technical_complexity.rationale: Clinically validated ML on ECG signals plus a regulatory path for software that informs drug dosing; needs clinical studies.

defensibility.rationale: Clearance and clinical validation would be a barrier, but the product is still under development and AliveCor and others were already in drug monitoring.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action found against SafeBeat; the company remains active and unsold per its site.

market_need_then: AliveCor's 2021 clearance for QTc tracking and its plan to partner with drug makers show demand for remote drug safety ECG monitoring.

branding.domain_note: Uses safebeat.com; legal entity appears as SafeBeat Rx. An unrelated space company also goes by SafeBeat.

identity.voice_and_tone: Clinical, tagline Designed for Clinicians, by Clinicians

rebrands.why: Not stated; both names are used interchangeably in sources

brand_strength.rationale: A clear, easily remembered name linking safety and heartbeat; little press or community evidence.

outcome_analysis: SafeBeat is physician led and has moved slowly through the regulated path: still marked under development and not for sale, it won a 2 million NIH SBIR grant in August 2025 for a UCSF atrial fibrillation study and reached SOC 2 Type 2 in August 2026 per its site. Capital is mostly nondilutive, with no confirmed venture round.
notes: Total raised is unverified: CB Insights says 2.28M over 5 rounds, Caplight 2.71M, another listing 280K; aggregators only, so no venture rounds recorded. The grant is dated August 6 2025 by MedTech Innovator while CB Insights says August 5. Founding year 2021 per YC page; one aggregator says 2020 and Saint Louis. Founder education and prior employers not found. The AliveCor source is dated July 2021, within the batch.
